<p dir="auto">Two-app monorepo sharing one MySQL database:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>php_payroll/</strong> — HRMS Admin Panel (PHP, PDO, sessions)</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Entry: <code>index.php</code> → <code>config/config.php</code> → <code>includes/database.php</code></li>
<li>Auth: <code>includes/class.auth.php</code> (Auth class, session-based, DB rate limiting)</li>
<li>Template: <code>templates/header.php</code> (HTML with Bootstrap 5, DataTables, Select2 CDNs)</li>
<li>Routing: <code>index.php</code> dispatches to <code>modules/{module}/{action}.php</code></li>
<li>272 PHP files total</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>api/ess/</strong> — Employee Self-Service API (PHP, mysqli, JWT)</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Entry points: <code>login.php</code>, <code>pin.php</code>, <code>sync.php</code>, <code>attendance.php</code>, <code>leaves.php</code>, etc.</li>
<li>Auth: <code>config.php</code> (validateApiKey, requireAuth, SimpleJWT)</li>
<li>Shared helpers: <code>helpers.php</code> (jsonOutput, getInput, safeBindParam, verifyPin, hashPin, determineEssRole)</li>
<li>CORS: <code>cors.php</code> (strict HTTPS whitelist)</li>
<li>Security headers: <code>security-headers.php</code></li>
<li>27 PHP files</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>RCS_ESS/</strong> — ESS Frontend (Vite + React, TypeScript)</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Not in scope for backend security fixes</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>

<li>Shared MySQL, tables: <code>employees</code>, <code>users</code>, <code>roles</code>, <code>clients</code>, <code>units</code>, <code>ess_employee_cache</code>, <code>login_attempts</code>, <code>payroll_*</code>, <code>attendance_*</code>, etc.</li>
<li><code>ess_employee_cache</code> stores ESS-specific data including hashed PINs</li>
<li><code>login_attempts</code> tracks failed login attempts for both admin and ESS</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Key Security Implementations (Phase 1+2)</h2><a id="user-content-key-security-implementations-phase-12" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Key Security Implementations (Phase 1+2)" href="#key-security-implementations-phase-12"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>PINs: bcrypt hashed via <code>password_hash()</code>/<code>password_verify()</code> with auto-upgrade from plaintext</li>
<li>Rate limiting: DB-backed <code>login_attempts</code> table, progressive lockout (5→15min, 10→1hr, 20→24hr)</li>
<li>File uploads: <code>finfo_file()</code> MIME detection + GD re-encoding</li>
<li>RBAC: Role-based access on all API routes</li>
<li>CORS: Strict HTTPS-only whitelist</li>
<li>Error handling: Generic client messages + server-side error_log</li>
<li>Security headers: X-Frame-Options, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy</li>
</ul>
